story: After early attacks, Söderqvist broke away solo before being joined by four riders, building a maximum gap of 2:45. A deer briefly threatened the peloton around 125 km from the finish. Crosswinds later split the bunch into echelons, with UAE Team Emirates-XRG controlling the front. Cosnefroy attacked in the final 500 metres, dropping Teunissen to claim the stage win and the overall lead.
